LanguageData.RatkinQL_PeirinCh1Tree_Report: A scruffy young ratkin peddler shows up at your gate, hawking wares.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch1_Greeting: A young ratkin with a patched pack and a hopeful grin pushes through your doorway, calling out to {Interviewer_labelShort} in a bright, breathless voice: "Good day! Fresh goods from the road—hardtack, herbs, little trinkets! Fair prices, I swear!" She puffs her chest a bit too much, as if daring you to doubt her.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch1_Story1: "Me? Oh, just call me Walnut—a young rat out to see the road. Family? Well… that's a story for another day, eh? Maybe when we're old friends." She winks, clearly dodging the question with practiced ease.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch1_Story2: "All I'll say is this: I'm out to make my own name, carve my own trade route. No one's shadow but my own." She nods firmly, as if convincing herself as much as you.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch1_OptTrade: Buy her wares at face price (15 silver)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch1_OptFund: Give her a grant, no goods needed (50 silver)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch1_OptFleece: Haggle her down to a pittance (5 silver)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch1_Farewell: "Right then! Next time I'll bring better stock, you'll see!" She beams, slinging her pack over her shoulder as she heads out, already chattering to herself about next season's route.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch1_MsgTrade: Walnut hands over the goods with a proud grin, pocketing the silver neatly.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch1_MsgFund: Walnut stares at the silver in disbelief, then bows her head. "I… I won't forget this. You have my word." She straightens, eyes bright with resolve.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch1_MsgFleece: Walnut's ears flatten. She shoves the goods at you without a word, her cheerful mask gone. "…Deal."
